title: everyone signs up the same way, and the zip sets the market

criteria.text: Signup collects legal name, email, zip and display name, plus an 18+/Terms box, and verifies the email
criteria.note: [V] one screen (OnboardingFlow.tsx, #497, review-skipped): four fields, the 18+ box with the Terms link to /terms; email confirmation is on (config.toml, EmailFirstSignup 'confirm-email'); deploy-health green on d5ebc93. Smoked: unknown, /onboarding has no stable address in smoke-live. unmarked: OnboardingFlow.test.tsx ('asks for exactly the fields F081 names', 'the 18+ box starts unticked'), profile.test.ts; the only marker (phone.test.ts) is partial and about the phone. Check ticket #851

criteria.text: The zip is stored and never rendered on any surface another member or visitor can reach
criteria.note: [V] members.zip (migration 20261007200000, #497); members readable only by self (migration 20260930180000); the member's own zip shows only on /you (ZipChange). Nothing found that shows it to anyone else (grep 2026-10-16), but absence of code proves nothing: no standing guard, ticket #852

criteria.text: The zip decides the market, the screen names it, and nothing else decides it
criteria.note: [V] marketForZip → completeOnboardingAction → 'shows which market' (zip-market.ts, #709 F103/T694; review-skipped; deploy-health green on 4f571f5). The 2026-10-11 ruling that a visitor's IP guess is confirmed with 'Is this your area?' (#588, F059.6, open, needs-pm) is not part of signup and not built here [A]. Smoked: unknown. Markers are F103.2/F103.3 partial only; check ticket #853

criteria.text: Nobody picks a market at signup; changing the zip on /you moves the market and home town
criteria.note: [V] no picker at signup; ZipChange + zip-set re-resolve market and home town (#757 F103/T695, closed #568; review-skipped; deploy-health green on e0f16a9). /you also has a 'Metro' row (DefaultMetro) that sets where the member looks, a different thing from the market the zip decides [A]. Smoked: unknown, /you loads but the change is an action. Both markers are `[guards F081.4 partial]`; check ticket #854

criteria.text: A line says what the app is for, and no line about not selling member information
criteria.note: [V] COPY.signupLine shown on the signup screens (copy.ts; EmailFirstSignup, OnboardingFlow; #497, review-skipped). No never-sell line on the signup screens (grep 2026-10-16; the landing page has its own wording). Smoked: unknown. EmailFirstSignup.test.tsx is [guards F081.5 partial: presence only]; check ticket #855

criteria.text: No field, control or string in signup asks or records whether the person makes or finds
criteria.note: [V] the screen has the four fields and the 18+ box only; no such column on members. unmarked: OnboardingFlow.test.tsx ('never asks whether the person makes or finds', text only). Check ticket #856

criteria.text: Onboarding assigns no place the person did not give; home is the market and town the zip decided
criteria.note: [V] completeOnboardingAction writes no place (#283, #497); the home town comes from the zip (F103.5, #757). Checked: yes, src/app/onboarding/actions.test.ts ('writes no home place for anyone') carries [guards F081.7]. Reviewed: no (#283 no Reviewed by, #497 skipped)

criteria.text: Every US zip resolves to its county and market; an unknown zip is refused with the exact message; a waiting-market zip joins its waitlist
criteria.note: [V] national zip_county table loaded by migration 20261012030000 (applied 2026-10-12; tests/zip-market-db.test.ts 'the table is national'); unknown zip refused with "We don't recognize that zip, try again." (onboarding/actions.ts). Source is Census ZCTA not HUD-USPS, so a PO-box-only zip is unknown here (migration header); that swap is not recorded in the scenario [A]. #709 review-skipped. Smoked: unknown. Markers F103.2/F103.3 partial only; check ticket #853

criteria.text: Phone verification refuses a non-fixed VoIP number before any code is sent, with a plain message asking for a mobile number
criteria.note: [V] line-type.ts + checkPhoneAction + PhoneVerifyStep (#749; review-skipped; deploy-health green on 7f2db1a). A stub until the Twilio keys exist and Lookup is enabled (#707, the PM's): with no credentials it blocks nothing, and the whole phone gate is off behind PHONE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED (ruling 2026-10-11, option A). Smoked: unknown. Both markers are `[guards F081.9 partial]`; check ticket #857
